# Security

Report a vulnerability privately. Do not open a public GitHub issue for it, and do not include exploit details, credentials, or proof-of-concept data in a public place.

This repository does not publish a security email address. GitHub private vulnerability reporting on [gluzio/agentbuildkit](https://github.com/gluzio/agentbuildkit) is the channel to use when that feature is enabled for the repository. This file does not mean that feature is already enabled.

Until a private channel is available, contact the repository owner directly.
